title: Bind the chart-339 reader cut to all 48 actual rational calls
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The three protected chart-339 arrivals are independent when pulled back through the actual rational caller. Across all 48 calls, a product minor supported on fresh helpers has rank 144 with determinant (1/32)^48. Those directions have zero response in the 400 main native terminal fields, so the exhibited inputs do not feed the later roots. This establishes scalar information rank. Charging it as geometric grade or tariff requires another implication.

## Task and overlap

The immutable rational word, layout and application come from #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. The initial three-reader cut is included with clarified hypotheses. #7867 concerns rechart pricing. The active rational component experiments use different literal edits.

## Validation and credit

A clean offline copy of python3 -B replay.py passed in 10.32 s. It checks the initial readers, all 48 source-bound call pullbacks and the retained frame. A tampered rank claim was rejected after recomputation. An independent reviewer checked the determinant and source replay. Work was AI-assisted with Codex. The original rational, caller and P104 contributors are credited in the captured source notices.

## Open next questions

A physical repair grade, changed signed price, and new κ remain open.
